inventoryMethod: Eight explicit page-layout and paragraph-composition contracts validated against current WPF and Avalonia source tokens.

workflows.surface: WPF-authoritative Margins/Paper/Layout tabs plus quick geometry routes
workflows.lifecycle: Owner-modal; OK applies once; Cancel, Escape, and window close return no result; Layout launchers defer to backed routes.
workflows.validation: PageSetupDialogPlanner validates non-negative margins/distances and positive geometry.
workflows.resultApplication: PageLayoutCommandPlanner applies the full result through one SetPageSettingsCommand and one layout refresh.

workflows.surface: Columns presets and owner-modal More Columns dialog
workflows.lifecycle: Preset routes apply immediately; dialog OK applies once; Cancel, Escape, and close do not mutate.
workflows.validation: ColumnsDialogPlanner validates count 1-12 and non-negative spacing and owns unequal-width presets.
workflows.resultApplication: The selected page settings are committed through one undoable page-settings command.

workflows.surface: Immediate page, column, and section break menu routes
workflows.lifecycle: Each route inserts one backed break at the current selection or caret; no dialog is involved.
workflows.validation: SectionBreakKind constrains section modes and editor insertion guards the active selection.
workflows.resultApplication: One document command inserts each break and invalidates layout.
workflows.sharedPolicy: Core break model and editor command bus

workflows.surface: Layout Paragraph controls and two-tab Paragraph dialog
workflows.lifecycle: Dialog OK applies all indents, spacing, and pagination flags once to selected paragraphs; Cancel, Escape, and close do not mutate.
workflows.validation: ParagraphBreaksDialogPlanner owns parsing and pagination result construction.
workflows.resultApplication: Selection-scoped formatting is grouped into one undo entry and rerendered.

workflows.surface: Owner-modal Custom Paragraph Spacing dialog from Design
workflows.lifecycle: Default button accepts; Cancel, Escape, and close return null; invalid OK remains open and focuses the failing field.
workflows.validation: CustomParagraphSpacingDialogPlanner owns ranges, field-specific errors, and spacing-set construction.
workflows.resultApplication: The accepted document spacing set applies through the existing document-wide spacing command.

workflows.surface: Drop Cap presets and owner-modal Drop Cap Options dialog
workflows.lifecycle: Default button accepts; Cancel, Escape, and close return null; focus starts on lines-to-drop.
workflows.validation: DropCapOptionsDialogPlanner owns position mapping, defaults, and bounded lines/distance.
workflows.resultApplication: Accepted position applies or clears the current paragraph drop cap in one selection-scoped command.

workflows.surface: Checked None/Automatic modes, owner-modal per-word manual review, and owner-modal options
workflows.lifecycle: Mode routes apply immediately; manual review presents Yes/No/Cancel for each candidate; options OK applies once; Cancel, Escape, and close preserve already accepted manual choices without changing automatic mode.
workflows.validation: HyphenationOptionsDialogPlanner validates zone and consecutive-limit values; ManualHyphenationPlanner owns candidate order and valid break positions.
workflows.resultApplication: Backed settings apply through one undoable page-settings command; accepted manual breaks apply as one undoable U+00AD body-text command.

workflows.surface: Checked line-number modes and owner-modal options
workflows.lifecycle: Mode routes apply immediately; options OK applies once; Cancel, Escape, and close do not mutate.
workflows.validation: LineNumberOptionsDialogPlanner validates positive Start At and Count By values.
workflows.resultApplication: Mode, start, and count apply through one undoable page-settings command and one layout refresh.

remainingLimitations.exactWork: Capture matching WPF/Avalonia opened, populated, validation, and cancel states at 96 DPI to compare exact dimensions, tab geometry, focus cues, clipping, and nonblank pixels.
OS window chrome, native font shaping, focus rectangles, and message presentation remain toolkit/platform rendered and are not expected to be pixel-identical.
